offer.title: Your application
offer.intro: Hello {name}. This is your signed application: what is insured, what it costs, why we recommend it and what you need to know before the contract is concluded.
offer.approved: Pax has reviewed and released your application. Your policy starts on {date}.

policy.title: Your policy
policy.intro: Hello {name}. Your policy confirms the insurance cover you agreed with Pax.

sections.information: Information before the contract is concluded

cover.pensionDue: after a {months}-month waiting period, until {date} at the latest

information.intro: Pax owes you this information before the contract is concluded (Art. 3 of the Swiss Insurance Contract Act, VVG).
information.insurerValue: Pax, Schweizerische Lebensversicherungs-Gesellschaft AG, a company limited by shares with its registered office in Basel, Aeschenplatz 13, 4002 Basel, www.pax.ch

risk.todesfall: Survivors' protection (death): if the insured person dies before the contract ends, Pax pays the agreed death benefit.
risk.erwerbsunfaehigkeit: Income protection (disability): if the insured person is unable to work, Pax pays the agreed pension after the waiting period, depending on the degree of disability, until the contract ends at the latest.
risk.lifestar: Pension savings with a fund investment, plus survivors' protection (death) and income protection (disability) as set out in the benefits above.
risk.fondsstar: Pension savings with a fund investment, plus survivors' protection (death) and income protection (disability) as set out in the benefits above.
risk.pax3a: Pension savings in pillar 3a as set out in the benefits above.
risk.auszahlungsplan: Temporary annuity: Pax pays out the invested capital in regular amounts until the contract ends.
risk.kinderversicherung: Provision for your child as set out in the benefits above.
risk.care: Immediate help on death: Pax pays the agreed capital to your family quickly.
risk.other: As set out in the benefits above.

information.scopeValue: The insured benefits and amounts are listed above under “Benefits”.
information.withdrawalValue: You can withdraw your application within 14 days, in writing or in any other form that allows proof by text, for example by e-mail (Art. 2a VVG). The period starts with your signature on {signed} and runs until and including {deadline}. It is enough to notify Pax of the withdrawal or hand it to the post office on that day.
information.dataValue: Pax processes your personal data for advice, the application and the contract in line with the Swiss Data Protection Act; more at www.pax.ch/datenschutz. In this prototype you can download or delete your data at any time in your pension cockpit.

approval.inReview: A Pax advisor reviews your application and contacts you if anything needs to change. Once released, your policy starts on {date}.
